tactics: have key : ∀ (l : List α) (h : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) h ∧ motive l h := by intro l h; induction h with | head as => have hb : List.Mem.below (motive := motive) (List.Mem.head as) := by constructor; exact ⟨hb, F _ _ hb⟩ | tail b h ih => have hb : List.Mem.below (motive := motive) (List.Mem.tail b h) := by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2 | exact ih | trivial; exact ⟨hb, F _ _ hb⟩

have key : ∀ (l : List α) (h : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) h ∧ motive l h := by intro l h; induction h with | head as => exact ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2 | exact ih, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2 | exact ih)⟩

have key : ∀ (l : List α) (h : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) h ∧ motive l h := by intro l h; induction h with | head as => exact ⟨List.Mem.below.head as, F _ _ (List.Mem.below.head as)⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨List.Mem.below.tail b h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ (List.Mem.below.tail b h ih.1 ih.2)⟩
